messages:
emma: paging: seeing a sudden spike of 502s from Frontdoor -> Edge after the route-weight rollout at ~03:04 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts. dashboard shows request rate steady but 5xx jump. tagging oncall.
monitor-bot: ALERT: frontdoor.5xx_rate > threshold (90s avg) — 502s now ~18% of traffic for route /api/v1/generate. First triggered at 2026-03-15T03:06:12Z.
liam: oncall here, looking. any recent deploys?
emma: we rolled a route-weight change to split traffic 70/30 to variant-b earlier at 03:03:50. no binary deploys.
sana: seeing envoy clusters reporting upstream connection failure rates to pool-variant-b; logs show 502 response codes being generated by gateway rather than upstream 5xx.
raj: likely candidate: route shadowing + retry policy interaction. The new weight exposed a path that hits a legacy backend with stricter circuit_breaker settings.
liam: can someone paste the latest route config?
emma: pasted below (apologies messy):
```yaml
- route: /api/v1/generate
  weighted_clusters:
    variant-a: 70
    variant-b: 30
  retry_policy:
    retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure,refused-stream"
    num_retries: 3
  circuit_breakers:
    default:
      max_connections: 100
      max_pending_requests: 200
      max_requests: 1000
```
liam: aha — retry_policy + variant-b having stricter envoy upstream limits could amplify transient probe failures into cascaded 502s. the retries are likely creating extra load and tripping existing circuit_breakers.
diane: customers: we've got 4 support tickets flagged P1 for timeouts in the last 10m. which segments impacted?
monitor-bot: top impacted clusters: eu-west-1 and us-east-1. impacted customers: health-checking shows spike across both regions.
raj: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback weight change to 100% variant-a 2) set retry_policy.num_retries: 0 on the route 3) temporarily relax circuit_breaker max_pending_requests on variant-b
liam: do 2) immediately (turn off retries) and 1) if we see continued 5xx. turning off retries is lower risk. I can apply an Envoy route override via the control plane patch.
emma: running patch now: `rwctl routes patch --route /api/v1/generate --set 'retry_policy.num_retries=0'`
deploy-bot: deploy triggered for route-override (change-id: co-3245). apply started.
liam: also throwing a quick curl test against variant-b backend directly to confirm failure mode: `curl -i -sS -H "Host: api.prod" https://variant-b.internal/api/v1/generate`
sana: logs from variant-b show repeated upstream reset: `upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: CONNECTION_FAILURE`
liam: that aligns — upstream instances likely overwhelmed or healthcheck failing. once retries off we should stop amplifying the resets into extra load.
monitor-bot: Route override applied (change-id: co-3245) — observed 30s after: 5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 7% (30s avg).
diane: customer impact update: support triage updated tickets to "mitigated" and notified customers of partial degradation. keeping P1 until fully under SLA.
emma: logs: sample access logs around 03:08 (before override):
```
03:07:58 GET /api/v1/generate 200 120ms variant-a
03:07:59 GET /api/v1/generate 502 15ms variant-b -> envoy_response_code 502 via route
03:08:00 GET /api/v1/generate 502 12ms variant-b
03:08:01 GET /api/v1/generate 502 14ms variant-b
```
liam: can we double-check circuit_breaker config for variant-b? current default was low on max_connections. if variant-b is a new fleet, healthchecks may be too tight.
raj: pulling envoy cluster config for variant-b: `max_connections: 50`, `max_pending_requests: 50`, `circuit_breakers: thresholds: max_local_requests: 100`. that's indeed stricter than variant-a.
sana: suggestion: increment max_pending_requests to 300 for variant-b temporarily, and run canary traffic back at 10% to validate.
liam: agree. I'll flip overrides: increase pending -> 300 and re-enable weight to 90/10 (variant-a/variant-b) after increase. switching steps: (a) envoy config override for cluster variant-b pending requests, (b) adjust route weight to 90/10, (c) monitor 5xx.
emma: patch 1 applied: `rwctl cluster patch variant-b --set 'max_pending_requests=300'`
deploy-bot: cluster patch co-3246 applied to control plane; proxies pick up new config via xDS.
monitor-bot: after config change: 5xx down to 3.2% (2m avg).
liam: doing weight nudge to 90/10 now: `rwctl routes patch --route /api/v1/generate --set 'weighted_clusters.variant-b=10'`
deploy-bot: route change co-3247 applied.
monitor-bot: 5xx now 1.1% (1m avg), error budget largely intact.
diane: great. please prepare post-incident notes: root cause hypothesis = retry amplification + misaligned cluster circuit_breaker thresholds for variant-b exposed by route weight change. action items: rollback default retries for routes with heterogeneous backends, add pre-rollout config checks for cluster thresholds vs route retry settings, and run a load soak on variant fleets before shifting traffic.
liam: oncall handoff: I'll stay until fully stable for 30m, then pass to infra-oncall. Infra followups: audit cluster cb settings + healthcheck tuning.
infra-oncall: ack. I'll schedule a fix to harmonize thresholds and add automated preflight gate for route weight changes.
emma: tagging for postmortem: @diane @liam @raj @sana — will draft the timeline and rough impact numbers.
monitor-bot: incident closed as "mitigated" at 2026-03-15T03:20:31Z (objects: route-override co-3245, cluster patch co-3246, route revert co-3247).
emma: thanks team. followup doc requested in #postmortems with timeline and config diffs. :thumbsup:
